The eProcurement Ontology Submission core describes the concepts and properties representing the European Public Procurement Submission domain. The provision of these semantics offers the basis for a common understanding of the domain for all stakeholders ensuring the quality of data exchange and transparency. The ontology restrictions are published in a separate artefact.
